safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated mentions prescribing a topical steroid but does not document the twice-daily (BD) frequency specified in Gold (Plan_of_Care-002 lacks dosing frequency).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the intended dosing frequency for a prescribed topical steroid can lead to incorrect use (underuse with persistent symptoms or overuse with increased risk of local adverse effects like skin thinning), potentially delaying symptom control. While typically not life-threatening, it can cause avoidable treatment failure and follow-up visits.
